data.name: Armbruster
data.gender_notes: Armbruster is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name derived from the Old German elements 'arm' meaning 'arm' and 'brust' meaning 'rock'. Historically, this name was given to someone who was strong and protected their people like a rock. The name Armbruster carries the meaning “Arms of the rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armbruster usually hope their child will grow to embody arms of the rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carries the symbolic message of strength and protection.
data.etymology: Armbruster belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Arms of the rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Armbruster total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Armbruster has its roots in Old German culture and history, mimicking the strength and fortitude of the Germanic people. With 'arm' meaning 'arm' and 'brust' meaning 'rock', Armbruster was a name for a protector, a warrior who would shield his people from harm with the strength of a rock.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Armbruster carries a deep spiritual meaning as well. The 'rock' in the name symbolizes steadfastness, unwavering faith, and unbreakable spiritual foundation. It reminding the bearer of their inner call to be a rock, a foundation of unwavering faith, and a stronghold for those around them, just as God is a reliable foundation and a stronghold for His children.
